messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: I am getting this error - returnFileNamesMissingTags
parts:
Hi,
as I mentioned in the links, it is a bug in the current version 1.0. 
You get the same error with version 0.99.9? This seems odd, as I only added this argument in version 1.0. Can you check again please which version of camtrapR you are using? I.e., uninstall and then install version 0.99.9 from a local zip file. Upon loading camtrapR with library(camtrapR) you should get a message that a new version is available. 
Best,
Jürgen
